text: ユイちゃんと　あたしと　いっしょに　しょうぶが　いいの！

structure.jp: ユイちゃんと　あたしと　いっしょに
しょうぶが　いいの！
structure.en: a battle is what I want!

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A thing plus がいい says that is the one you want or prefer. しょうぶが　いい = 'I want a battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is the soft girlish form of のだ, which adds feeling as if explaining yourself. いいの = 'that's what I want, you see'.
